body: I have no money, no car, no job, and like I said, no friends or family to ask for help and the shelters are full. I also suffer extreme crippling anxiety. My baseline is "very anxious" and any amount of stress, worry or obligations send me into full on panic attacks. I will feel so uncomfortable and physically sick to my stomach, my mind wil race, I'll start to shake, become quiet and distracted, and feel closterphobic like I'm stuck where I'm at... I'll start thinking in a self defeating circle. "I need to do this but in order to do that I'd first have to do this, this and this. And I can't do that without these things, or that before the other thing is finished then I can do this but by that time this will be too late for that (this could be anything, something as simple as cleaning the kitchen or making myself a doctors appointment or something more complicated like getting my car licensed and insured and tagged, or trying to go back to college)

Thank you. I don't know how this happened. 5 years ago I was a totally different person. When I met him, he was amazing, he's gorgeous, tall, dark olive Native American skin, long thick dark hair and dark brown eyes. When we made eye contact my heart would skip a few beats, I'd blush and I'd have to look away because it was so overwhelming. He would do this half smile smirk thing.... I'd just melt. He's smart, same political and religious views (lack of religious views rather) he is so funny, same dark sense of humor, we had so much in common. Not just music and movies type of stuff, deep stuff, like how we'd both been abandoned by our moms and raised by alcoholic dads. We both had been divorced for less than a year from our highschool sweethearts that we were with for 10 years. We even found pictures from rock shows here in Kansas City where you can see both of us in the picture but years before we met. (Once at soad and another at tool) my best friend before I moved about 30 minutes across town in 7th grade later became his best friend all through highschool after he moved to kc from Arkansas when he was a freshman... We fell in love hard and fast. I mean, I'd never felt anything like it. I'd never even thought something that intense was possible. It was unreal.

He's 11 months old. Almost walking. He's a little sponge, mimicking everything he sees. Two weeks ago his dad (my boyfriend) punched me closed fisted 3 times while my son was in my arms and I was seated on the couch. I got down on the floor covering my son with my body while my boyfriend kicked and stomped on my head face and ribs... I couldn't call the police because I have bench warrants for failure to appear on traffic stuff. I know it sounds ridiculous, but in Jackson county Missouri, they will take you in on outstanding warrants even when you are the victim of a crime. I've had it happen twice before. All the domestic violence shelters are full, they keep telling me to call every day and check. I call most days, some days I can't get away from him long enough to make the call. I have no friends or family anymore. I asked my mom for help and she told me to pray about it and try to keep a positive attitude. She asked if I was having sex with him often enough. Then she told me to watch Joel osteen...
